## Pull Request Description

### Summary of Changes
- Provide a high-level summary of what this pull request introduces or fixes.

### Related Issue
Closes # [issue number]

### Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] CI/CD or Infrastructure update

### Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have added unit / integration / Selenium tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] No merge conflicts with the base branch
